key_concepts: Applied force can change an object's velocity.
Work is done when a force causes displacement.
A moving object has energy that can move other objects.
Potential energy is stored energy due to position or condition.
Kinetic energy is the energy of motion.

Mechanical energy includes potential and kinetic energy.
A pendulum converts potential energy to kinetic energy and back as it swings.
Pendulum period is the time for one full swing and depends on pendulum length.
An inflated balloon stores potential energy that converts to kinetic energy when released.
